verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा सेनापतिं प्राप्तं भरतं केकयाधिपः ।युधाजिद्गार्ग्यसहितं परां प्रीतिमुपागमत् ।। ७.१०१.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā senāpatiṁ prāptaṁ bharataṁ kekayādhipaḥ ।yudhājidgārgyasahitaṁ parāṁ prītimupāgamat ।। 7.101.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that Commander Bharata had arrived, the King of Kekaya, accompanied by Yudhajit and Gargya, attained great joy.
translations.hindi: % पाठान्तरे--“मद्दामते ।” ७७६ उत्तरकाण्डे जब महात्मा भरत जी से श्रोरामचन्द्र जी ने इस प्रकार कहा, तब लक्ष्मण जी ने श्रीराम चन्द्र जी से यह मनोहर वचन कहे

verses.sloka: स निर्ययौ जनौघेन महता केकयाधिपः ।त्वरमाणो ऽभिचक्राम गन्धर्वान्कामरूपिणः ।। ७.१०१.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa niryayau janaughena mahatā kekayādhipaḥ ।tvaramāṇo 'bhicakrāma gandharvānkāmarūpiṇaḥ ।। 7.101.2 ॥

translations.english: The King of Kekaya went out with a great multitude of people, hurrying to approach the Gandharvas who could change their form at will.
translations.hindi: हे रघुनन्दन ! सम्पूण पापो से पवित्र करने बाला अश्बमे ध यज्ञ है । हे दुधर्ष! याइ तुम्दारी इच्छा यज्ञ हो करने की हे तो यह्‌ यज्ञ कीजिए

verses.sloka: भरतश्च युधाजिच्च समेतौ लघुविक्रमैः ।गन्धर्वनगरं प्राप्तौ सबलौ सपदानुगौ ।। ७.१०१.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: bharataśca yudhājicca sametau laghuvikramaiḥ ।gandharvanagaraṁ prāptau sabalau sapadānugau ।। 7.101.3 ॥

translations.english: Bharata and Yudhajit, accompanied by swift warriors, arrived together at the city of the Gandharvas with their army and followers.
translations.hindi: एक पुरानी कथा ऐसी सुनी जाती हे कि, इन्द्र को जिस समय बरह्महत्या लगी थी, उस समय उन्होंने यही यज्ञ किआ था और इसके करने से बे पवित्र हुए थे

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु भरतं प्राप्तं गन्धर्वास्ते समागताः ।योद्धुकामा महावीर्या व्यनदन् वै समन्ततः ।। ७.१०१.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu bharataṁ prāptaṁ gandharvāste samāgatāḥ ।yoddhukāmā mahāvīryā vyanadan vai samantataḥ ।। 7.101.4 ॥

translations.english: Having heard of Bharata's arrival, those mighty Gandharvas, eager to fight, assembled and roared from all directions.
translations.hindi: हे महाबाहो ! पबेकाल में देवासुरयुद्ध में लोकपूजित वृत्र नाम का एक बड़ा नामी दैत्य था

verses.sloka: ततः समभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ।सप्तरात्रं महाभीमं न चान्यतरयोर्जयः ।। ७.१०१.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṁ tumulaṁ romaharṣaṇam ।saptarātraṁ mahābhīmaṁ na cānyatarayorjayaḥ ।। 7.101.5 ॥

translations.english: Then, a tumultuous, hair-raising, and exceedingly dreadful battle ensued for seven nights, with neither side achieving victory.
translations.hindi: वह सौ योजन चौड़ा और तीन सौ योजन लंबा था। तोनों लोकों पर अपना स्वत्वांधिकार होने का उसे अभिमान था और बह तीनों लोकों को स्नेह की दृष्टि से देखता था

translations.english: Rivers of flowing blood, carrying human corpses and resembling streams with swords, spears, and bows as their aquatic creatures, flowed in all directions.
translations.hindi: बई बड़ा धमज्ञ, कृतज्ञ ओर बुद्धिमान था। वह भरीपूरी व्रथिबी का धर्म से { इमानदारी से) सावधानतापूवक शासन करता था

verses.sloka: ततो रामानुजः क्रुद्धः कालस्यास्त्रं सुदारुणम् ।संवर्तं नाम भरतो गन्धर्वेष्वभ्यचोदयत् ।। ७.१०१.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato rāmānujaḥ kruddhaḥ kālasyāstraṁ sudāruṇam ।saṁvartaṁ nāma bharato gandharveṣvabhyacodayat ।। 7.101.7 ॥

translations.english: Then, the enraged Bharata, Rama's younger brother, discharged the exceedingly terrible weapon of Time, named Samvarta, upon the Gandharvas.
translations.hindi: उसके राज्य में यह प्रथिवी कामधेनु की तरह सम्पूर्ण पदार्थों को यथोचित रीत्या उत्पन्न करती थी और रसीले एवं स्वादिष्ट फल फूल और मूल होते थे

verses.sloka: ते बद्धाः कालपाशेन संवर्तेन विदारिताः ।क्षणेनाभिहतास्तेन तिस्रः कोट्यो महात्मनाम् ।। ७.१०१.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: te baddhāḥ kālapāśena saṁvartena vidāritāḥ ।kṣaṇenābhihatāstena tisraḥ koṭyo mahātmanām ।। 7.101.8 ॥

translations.english: Bound by the noose of Time and torn apart by the Samvarta weapon, three crores of those mighty Gandharvas were instantly struck down by Bharata.

verses.sloka: तं घातं घोरसङ्काशं न स्मरन्ति दिवौकसः ।निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तादृशानां महात्मनाम् ।। ७.१०१.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ ghātaṁ ghorasaṅkāśaṁ na smaranti divaukasaḥ ।nimeṣāntaramātreṇa tādṛśānāṁ mahātmanām ।। 7.101.9 ॥

translations.english: The gods do not even remember that terrible destruction of those great souls (Gandharvas), as it occurred within the mere twinkling of an eye.

verses.sloka: हतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु भरतः केकयीसुतः ।निवेशयामास तदा समृद्धे द्वे पुरोत्तमे ।। ७.१०१.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: hateṣu teṣu sarveṣu bharataḥ kekayīsutaḥ ।niveśayāmāsa tadā samṛddhe dve purottame ।। 7.101.10 ॥

translations.english: After all those (Gandharvas) were killed, Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi, then established two prosperous and excellent cities.

verses.sloka: तक्षं तक्षशिलायां तु पुष्कलं पुष्कलावते ।गन्धर्वदेशे रुचिरे गान्धारविषये च सः ।। ७.१०१.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: takṣaṁ takṣaśilāyāṁ tu puṣkalaṁ puṣkalāvate ।gandharvadeśe rucire gāndhāraviṣaye ca saḥ ।। 7.101.11 ॥

translations.english: He (Bharata) established Taksha in Takshashila and Pushkala in Pushkalavati, both in the beautiful land of Gandharvas, which is the region of Gandhara.
translations.hindi: उसे ऐसा तप करते देख, इन्द्र बढ़े दुःखो हो, विष्णु के पास गए और उनसे बोले

translations.english: These cities were filled with heaps of wealth and jewels, adorned with forests, and their extensive qualities caused mutual rivalry and competition.
translations.hindi: हे महाबाहो ! बृत्र ने तपोबल से सब लोकां को जीत लिआ है। एक तो बह्‌ बलवान दूसरे बद धर्मात्मा भी है । अतः में उसका शासन नहीं कर सकता

translations.english: Both cities were very beautiful in appearance, characterized by blameless transactions, full of gardens and conveyances, and had well-divided inner markets.
Both beautiful and excellent cities were adorned with extensive areas, featuring principal houses that were very charming and resembled celestial chariots.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे“ वृत्रेण निर्जिता ।” हे विष्णो ! जब से वह तुम्हारा प्रोतिपात्र बना हे, तभी से बह लोको का मालिक हो गया हे

translations.english: The cities were further adorned with beautiful and extensive temples, as well as with palm, tamala, tilaka, and vakula trees.
After establishing the cities over a period of five years, Bharata, the mighty-armed son of Kaikeyi and younger brother of Rama, returned to Ayodhya.
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌! अतएव तुम लोकां पर कृपा करो। तुम रे किए यह सारा जगत्‌ शान्त ओर व्यथारहित होगा

verses.sloka: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं साक्षाद्धर्ममिवापरम् ।राघवं भरतः श्रीमान्ब्रह्माणमिव वासवः ।। ७.१०१.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: so 'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ sākṣāddharmamivāparam ।rāghavaṁ bharataḥ śrīmānbrahmāṇamiva vāsavaḥ ।। 7.101.17 ॥

translations.english: The glorious Bharata, like Indra saluting Brahma, saluted the great-souled Rama, who was like another embodiment of Dharma itself.
translations.hindi: है विष्णो ! यह देवता लोग तम्हारी ही ओर दीनमुख हो देखते हैं । अतएवच उस वत्रासुर को मार कर, उनकी पूरी सहायता करो

verses.sloka: शशंस च यथावृत्तं गन्धर्ववधमुत्तमम् ।निवेशनं च देशस्य श्रुत्वा प्रीतो ऽस्य राघवः ।। ७.१०१.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: śaśaṁsa ca yathāvṛttaṁ gandharvavadhamuttamam ।niveśanaṁ ca deśasya śrutvā prīto 'sya rāghavaḥ ।। 7.101.18 ।।

translations.english: Bharata reported the full account of the excellent slaying of the Gandharvas and the establishment of the region, and upon hearing this, Rama was pleased with him. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 101 ।। Thus ends the hundred and first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
